svg.text: CLOSE THE DEAL / OFFICE LAYOUT STUDY
FLOW / lanes, vertical routes and sightline survey • TARGET CONCEPT • 15 NOV 2026
Two office neighbourhoods; linked loops; one shared forum.
40 px = 1m at native resolution / 4m grid / NW origin
Unity mapping: (x, y-plan) → (X, height, −y-plan) • doors 1.2 × 2.4m • walls 0.2m / partitions 0.1m
Blue hatch = upper void; pale blue ends = 2.4m landings; dashed guard opens at the stair ends.
DASHED BLUE = main loop CIRCLES = nodes DIAMONDS = landmarks B = shared briefcase start
Dashed arrows: F exposed stair / E1–E2 enclosed escape stairs / L loud lift (availability undecided).
